titulo: Atlassian (Mar 2026): $1.8 billion buying back its own stock, about 1,600 jobs decided to. The math.
caption:
From the archive: Mar 2026. Not today's news.
Atlassian, Mar 11, 2026 (CEO update to employees, 8-K): "I have made the incredibly difficult decision to reduce the size of our team"
In March 2026, Atlassian's CEO told employees, in an 8-K filing, it would cut about 10% of the team. Its fiscal 2026 10-K shows $1.8 billion spent buying back its own stock.

Same fiscal year: $1.8 billion buying back its own stock, fiscal 2026. $1,800,485 thousand paid to repurchase Class A common stock in fiscal 2026, company-wide (cash flow statement, in thousands).
The math: $1.8 billion in buybacks (2026) ÷ about 1,600 job cuts = about $1.12 million in buybacks per job cut.
The facts: $1.8 billion buying back its own stock, fiscal 2026 (SEC EDGAR · Atlassian, Aug 14, 2026). about 1,600 jobs decided to cut (SEC EDGAR · Atlassian, Mar 11, 2026). The buyback is Atlassian's full fiscal 2026 figure, July 2025 to June 2026. The March 2026 update falls inside that year. The job count is about 1,600, the CEO's own figure.

Incredibly difficult. Here is the buyback column. (Our take.)

Send this to someone who got that update.

Sources: SEC EDGAR · Atlassian, Mar 11, 2026; SEC EDGAR · Atlassian, Aug 14, 2026.

More at the link in bio.
